/**
 * Format helper untuk Scene Prompt Studio.
 *
 * Fitur 2: buildOverlayVisualCopyText — copy gabungan Overlay + Visual per scene
 * Fitur 3: buildBatchExportText — ekspor batch dengan delimiter untuk parse-engine eksternal
 * Fitur 88: buildUnifiedVisualPrompt — format terpadu [durasi] + [scene context] + [Visual Prompt]
 */

export interface SceneForExport {
  id: number;
  sceneNumber: string;
  sceneContext?: string;
  narasi: string;
  visual: string;
  teksOverlay?: string;
  overlayType?: "chapter_title" | "key_point";
  chapter?: number;
  chapterTitle?: string;
  durasi?: string;
  estimatedDurationSec?: number;
}

export interface UnifiedVisualPromptOptions {
  includeDuration?: boolean;
  includeContext?: boolean;
  locale?: string;
}

/**
 * Bangun format terpadu 1 kesatuan berbasis locale:
 * Jika English (en):
 * [duration : 5s]
 * [scene context]
 * ...
 * [Visual Prompt]
 * ...
 *
 * Jika Indonesian (id):
 * [durasi : 5 detik]
 * [konteks adegan]
 * ...
 * [Prompt Visual]
 * ...
 */
export function buildUnifiedVisualPrompt(
  scene: {
    visual: string;
    durasi?: string;
    estimatedDurationSec?: number;
    sceneContext?: string;
  },
  options: UnifiedVisualPromptOptions = { includeDuration: true, includeContext: true, locale: "id" }
): string {
  const isEn = options.locale === "en";
  const parts: string[] = [];

  // 1. Durasi
  if (options.includeDuration !== false) {
    const rawDurasi = scene.durasi?.trim();
    let durasiStr = "";
    if (rawDurasi && rawDurasi !== "—") {
      durasiStr = rawDurasi;
    } else if (scene.estimatedDurationSec !== undefined && scene.estimatedDurationSec > 0) {
      durasiStr = isEn ? `${scene.estimatedDurationSec}s` : `${scene.estimatedDurationSec} detik`;
    }

    if (durasiStr) {
      if (isEn) {
        const enDurasi = durasiStr.replace(/\s*detik/gi, "s");
        parts.push(`[duration : ${enDurasi}]`);
      } else {
        const idDurasi = durasiStr.replace(/(\d+)\s*s\b/gi, "$1 detik");
        parts.push(`[durasi : ${idDurasi}]`);
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Scene Context
  if (options.includeContext !== false && scene.sceneContext?.trim()) {
    const contextTag = isEn ? "[scene context]" : "[konteks adegan]";
    parts.push(`${contextTag}\n${scene.sceneContext.trim()}`);
  }

  // 3. Visual Prompt
  const visualClean = scene.visual && scene.visual !== "—" ? scene.visual.trim() : "";
  if (visualClean) {
    const visualTag = isEn ? "[Visual Prompt]" : "[Prompt Visual]";
    parts.push(`${visualTag}\n${visualClean}`);
  }

  return parts.join("\n");
}

// ─── Fitur 2: Overlay + Visual per scene ──────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Gabungkan teks overlay dan visual prompt menjadi satu teks terformat.
 * Dipakai tombol "Copy Overlay + Visual" per scene.
 */
export function buildOverlayVisualCopyText(scene: SceneForExport, locale: string = "id"): string {
  const isEn = locale === "en";
  const parts: string[] = [];

  if (scene.teksOverlay) {
    const overlayTag = isEn ? "[Screen Overlay Text]" : "[Teks Overlay Layar]";
    parts.push(`${overlayTag}\n${scene.teksOverlay}`);
  }

  const visual = scene.visual && scene.visual !== "—" ? scene.visual.trim() : "";
  if (visual) {
    const visualTag = isEn ? "[Visual Prompt]" : "[Prompt Visual]";
    parts.push(`${visualTag}\n${visual}`);
  }

  return parts.join("\n\n");
}

// ─── Fitur 3: Batch Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface BatchExportFilterOptions {
  includeNarasi: boolean;
  includeVisual: boolean;
  includeDurasi: boolean;
  includeContext: boolean;
  includeOverlay: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_BATCH_EXPORT_FILTER: BatchExportFilterOptions = {
  includeNarasi: true,
  includeVisual: true,
  includeDurasi: true,
  includeContext: true,
  includeOverlay: true,
};

const BATCH_START = "###PROMPTGEN_BATCH_EXPORT###";
const BATCH_END = "###PROMPTGEN_BATCH_EXPORT_END###";
const SCENE_DELIMITER = "---SCENE---";

/**
 * Sanitasi value agar tidak mengandung newline yang merusak format parser.
 * Tab dan newline diganti dengan spasi tunggal.
 */
function sanitizeField(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ").trim();
}

/**
 * Bangun teks batch export dari array scene yang dipilih dengan opsi filter dan locale.
 *
 * Logika Penyatuan (Fitur #88):
 * - Jika `includeVisual` aktif bersama `includeDurasi` atau `includeContext`:
 *   Kedua elemen tersebut otomatis melebur masuk ke dalam blok `VISUAL:` dalam format 1 kesatuan sesuai locale.
 * - Jika `includeVisual` tidak aktif, elemen `DURASI` dan `SCENE_CONTEXT` yang dicentang akan berdiri sendiri.
 */
export function buildBatchExportText(
  scenes: SceneForExport[],
  filter: BatchExportFilterOptions = DEFAULT_BATCH_EXPORT_FILTER,
  locale: string = "id"
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [BATCH_START, `TOTAL_SCENES:${scenes.length}`];

  scenes.forEach((scene, index) => {
    lines.push(SCENE_DELIMITER);
    lines.push(`SCENE_INDEX:${index + 1}`);
    lines.push(`SCENE_NUMBER:${sanitizeField(scene.sceneNumber)}`);

    if (scene.chapter !== undefined) {
      lines.push(`CHAPTER:${scene.chapter}`);
      if (scene.chapterTitle) lines.push(`CHAPTER_TITLE:${sanitizeField(scene.chapterTitle)}`);
    }

    // Jika visual tidak disertakan, sceneContext berdiri sendiri (jika dipilih)
    if (!filter.includeVisual && filter.includeContext && scene.sceneContext) {
      lines.push(`SCENE_CONTEXT:${sanitizeField(scene.sceneContext)}`);
    }

    // Narasi
    if (filter.includeNarasi) {
      lines.push(`NARASI:${sanitizeField(scene.narasi)}`);
    }

    // Visual Prompt
    if (filter.includeVisual) {
      // Jika durasi atau konteks dipilih, leburkan ke dalam VISUAL:
      if (filter.includeDurasi || filter.includeContext) {
        const unifiedVisual = buildUnifiedVisualPrompt(scene, {
          includeDuration: filter.includeDurasi,
          includeContext: filter.includeContext,
          locale,
        });
        lines.push(`VISUAL:\n${unifiedVisual}`);
      } else {
        lines.push(`VISUAL:${sanitizeField(scene.visual)}`);
      }
    }

    // Teks Overlay
    if (filter.includeOverlay && scene.teksOverlay) {
      lines.push(`OVERLAY:${sanitizeField(scene.teksOverlay)}`);
      if (scene.overlayType) lines.push(`OVERLAY_TYPE:${scene.overlayType}`);
    }

    // Jika visual tidak disertakan, durasi berdiri sendiri (jika dipilih)
    if (!filter.includeVisual && filter.includeDurasi && scene.durasi) {
      lines.push(`DURASI:${sanitizeField(scene.durasi)}`);
    }
  });

  lines.push(BATCH_END);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

import { promises as fs } from "fs";
import path from "path";
import crypto from "crypto";

// Hanya huruf kecil, angka, "_", "-", ".", "/" — tanpa ".." dan tanpa "//".
const KEY_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_\-./]{0,250}$/;

export function getStorageRoot(): string {
  const configured = process.env.STORAGE_DIR;
  if (configured && configured.trim()) return path.resolve(configured.trim());
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    throw new Error("STORAGE_DIR belum diatur di environment production.");
  }
  return path.resolve(process.cwd(), "storage");
}

function isNotFound(err: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "code" in err && (err as { code?: unknown }).code === "ENOENT";
}

function resolveKey(key: string): string {
  if (!KEY_PATTERN.test(key) || key.includes("..") || key.includes("//")) {
    throw new Error("Storage key tidak valid.");
  }
  const root = getStorageRoot();
  const full = path.resolve(root, key);
  if (!full.startsWith(root + path.sep)) {
    throw new Error("Storage key keluar dari folder penyimpanan.");
  }
  return full;
}

/** Tulis atomik: tulis ke file sementara lalu rename. */
export async function storagePut(key: string, data: Buffer): Promise<void> {
  const full = resolveKey(key);
  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(full), { recursive: true });
  const tmp = `${full}.${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}.tmp`;
  await fs.writeFile(tmp, data);
  await fs.rename(tmp, full);
}

export async function storageGet(key: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  try {
    return await fs.readFile(resolveKey(key));
  } catch (err) {
    if (isNotFound(err)) return null;
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function storageDelete(key: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await fs.unlink(resolveKey(key));
  } catch (err) {
    if (!isNotFound(err)) throw err;
  }
}

export interface StoredFileInfo {
  key: string;
  mtimeMs: number;
}

/** Daftar semua file di bawah sebuah prefix (untuk pembersih file yatim). */
export async function storageList(prefix: string): Promise<StoredFileInfo[]> {
  const root = getStorageRoot();
  const base = path.resolve(root, prefix);
  if (base !== root && !base.startsWith(root + path.sep)) throw new Error("Prefix tidak valid.");
  const out: StoredFileInfo[] = [];

  async function walk(dir: string): Promise<void> {
    let entries;
    try {
      entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch (err) {
      if (isNotFound(err)) return;
      throw err;
    }
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        await walk(full);
      } else if (entry.isFile()) {
        const stat = await fs.stat(full);
        out.push({ key: path.relative(root, full).split(path.sep).join("/"), mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs });
      }
    }
  }

  await walk(base);
  return out;
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getServerSession } from "next-auth/next";
import { authOptions } from "@/lib/authOptions";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/db";
import { hasFeature } from "@/lib/planFeatures";
import { requireActiveSubscription } from "@/lib/subscription";

export type StoryboardErrorCode =
  | "UNAUTHORIZED"
  | "RATE_LIMITED"
  | "SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE"
  | "FEATURE_LOCKED"
  | "DRAFT_NOT_FOUND"
  | "INVALID_INPUT"
  | "FILE_TOO_LARGE"
  | "INVALID_IMAGE"
  | "TOO_MANY_PANELS"
  | "QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
  | "STORAGE_ERROR"
  | "SERVER_ERROR";

export function storyboardError(status: number, errorCode: StoryboardErrorCode): NextResponse {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: errorCode, errorCode }, { status });
}

export type StoryboardAccess =
  | { ok: true; userId: string }
  | { ok: false; response: NextResponse };

/**
 * Cek berurutan: login → langganan aktif → fitur storyboardStudio ada di paket (superadmin selalu boleh).
 * Dipakai oleh semua route yang MENULIS data storyboard.
 */
export async function checkStoryboardAccess(): Promise<StoryboardAccess> {
  const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  const userId = session?.user?.id;
  if (!userId) return { ok: false, response: storyboardError(401, "UNAUTHORIZED") };

  try {
    await requireActiveSubscription(userId);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, response: storyboardError(403, "SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE") };
  }

  const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { role: true, currentPlan: { select: { features: true } } },
  });
  if (!dbUser) return { ok: false, response: storyboardError(401, "UNAUTHORIZED") };

  const isSuperadmin = dbUser.role === "SUPERADMIN";
  const rawFeatures = (dbUser.currentPlan?.features as Record<string, boolean>) ?? {};
  if (!hasFeature(rawFeatures, "storyboardStudio", isSuperadmin)) {
    return { ok: false, response: storyboardError(403, "FEATURE_LOCKED") };
  }
  return { ok: true, userId };
}

import { prisma } from "@/lib/db";
import { storageDelete } from "@/lib/storage";

/** Hapus semua file gambar milik sebuah draft (dipanggil SEBELUM draft dihapus dari DB). */
export async function deleteDraftStoryboardFiles(draftId: string): Promise<void> {
  const panels = await prisma.storyboardPanel.findMany({
    where: { draftId },
    select: { storageKey: true, thumbKey: true },
  });
  await Promise.all(panels.flatMap((p) => [storageDelete(p.storageKey), storageDelete(p.thumbKey)]));
}

import {
  ART_STYLE_KEYS,
  DEFAULT_STYLE_BIBLE,
  type ArtStyleKey,
  type StoryboardScene,
  type StyleBible,
} from "@/lib/storyboardPromptBuilder";

function isRecord(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}

function str(v: unknown): string {
  return typeof v === "string" ? v : "";
}

/**
 * Ambil daftar scene untuk storyboard dari Draft.parsedData.scenes.
 * Draft lama dari alur Generator (tanpa scenes[]) menghasilkan array kosong.
 */
export function extractStoryboardScenes(parsedData: unknown): StoryboardScene[] {
  if (!isRecord(parsedData) || !Array.isArray(parsedData.scenes)) return [];
  const out: StoryboardScene[] = [];
  for (const item of parsedData.scenes) {
    if (!isRecord(item)) continue;
    const visual = str(item.visual).trim();
    out.push({
      index: out.length + 1,
      context: str(item.sceneContext).trim() || undefined,
      visual: visual === "—" ? "" : visual,
      settingKamera: str(item.settingKamera).trim() || undefined,
      durasi: str(item.durasi).trim() || undefined,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Baca Draft.storyboard.styleBible dengan validasi; nilai tidak valid diganti default. */
export function readStyleBible(storyboard: unknown): StyleBible {
  if (!isRecord(storyboard) || !isRecord(storyboard.styleBible)) return { ...DEFAULT_STYLE_BIBLE };
  const sb = storyboard.styleBible;
  const art = ART_STYLE_KEYS.find((k: ArtStyleKey) => k === sb.artStyle) ?? DEFAULT_STYLE_BIBLE.artStyle;
  return {
    artStyle: art,
    customStyle: str(sb.customStyle),
    characters: str(sb.characters),
    palette: str(sb.palette),
    locations: str(sb.locations),
    extraRules: str(sb.extraRules),
  };
}

/** Rasio dari snapshot generationConfig; default 9:16. */
export function readAspectRatio(generationConfig: unknown): string {
  if (isRecord(generationConfig) && isRecord(generationConfig.videoConfig)) {
    const ar = str(generationConfig.videoConfig.aspectRatio).trim();
    if (ar) return ar;
  }
  return "9:16";
}

/** false hanya jika snapshot secara eksplisit mematikan camera movement. */
export function readCameraMovementEnabled(generationConfig: unknown): boolean {
  return !(isRecord(generationConfig) && generationConfig.cameraMovementEnabled === false);
}

export const ART_STYLE_KEYS = ["bw_sketch", "watercolor", "cinematic_semi_real", "cartoon_2d", "custom"] as const;
export type ArtStyleKey = (typeof ART_STYLE_KEYS)[number];

export interface StyleBible {
  artStyle: ArtStyleKey;
  customStyle: string;
  characters: string;
  palette: string;
  locations: string;
  extraRules: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_STYLE_BIBLE: StyleBible = {
  artStyle: "bw_sketch",
  customStyle: "",
  characters: "",
  palette: "",
  locations: "",
  extraRules: "",
};

export interface StoryboardScene {
  /** Urutan 1-based di daftar scene (sama dengan nomor panel). */
  index: number;
  context?: string;
  visual: string;
  settingKamera?: string;
  durasi?: string;
}

export interface CameraSetting {
  shotSize?: string;
  angle?: string;
  lens?: string;
  depthOfField?: string;
  movement?: string;
  composition?: string;
}

const ART_STYLE_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<Exclude<ArtStyleKey, "custom">, string> = {
  bw_sketch: "black-and-white pencil storyboard sketch, loose confident ink lines, light grey tonal shading, no color",
  watercolor: "soft watercolor storyboard illustration, light color washes, visible pencil outlines",
  cinematic_semi_real: "semi-realistic cinematic concept art, muted film-like color grading, soft volumetric light",
  cartoon_2d: "clean 2D cartoon illustration, bold outlines, flat colors",
};

/** Parse baris "ECU | low angle | 50mm | shallow DOF | slow push-in | rule of thirds". */
export function parseCameraSetting(raw?: string | null): CameraSetting | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const parts = raw.split("|").map((p) => p.trim());
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  const val = (i: number): string | undefined => (parts[i] && parts[i] !== "—" ? parts[i] : undefined);
  return {
    shotSize: val(0),
    angle: val(1),
    lens: val(2),
    depthOfField: val(3),
    movement: val(4),
    composition: val(5),
  };
}

export function describeAspectRatio(ar: string): string {
  const v = ar.trim();
  if (v === "9:16") return "vertical 9:16";
  if (v === "16:9") return "horizontal 16:9";
  if (v === "1:1") return "square 1:1";
  if (v === "4:5") return "vertical 4:5";
  return v || "vertical 9:16";
}

/**
 * Visual Prompt di aplikasi ini ditulis untuk KLIP VIDEO (ada --ar, [SFX], [BGM], "no voice over", dll).
 * Untuk panel storyboard (gambar diam) bagian-bagian itu dibuang.
 */
export function cleanVisualForStill(visual: string): string {
  return visual
    .replace(/--ar\s+\d+:\d+/gi, "")
    .replace(/\[(?:SFX|BGM)[^\]]*\]/gi, "")
    .replace(/\b(?:accompanied by|as background music|no sound effects|no background music|no voice[- ]?over)\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/\bwith\s*(?=[,.]|$)/gi, "")
    .replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+,/g, ",")
    .replace(/(?:,\s*){2,}/g, ", ")
    .replace(/^[,\s]+|[,\s]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
}

function styleDescription(bible: StyleBible): string {
  if (bible.artStyle === "custom") {
    return bible.customStyle.trim() || ART_STYLE_DESCRIPTIONS.bw_sketch;
  }
  return ART_STYLE_DESCRIPTIONS[bible.artStyle];
}

/** Prompt pertama yang ditempel user ke AI gambar: mengunci gaya & karakter. */
export function buildStyleBiblePrompt(bible: StyleBible, aspectRatio: string, topic: string): string {
  const lines = [
    "You are my storyboard artist. I will send you ONE panel description at a time.",
    'First, lock the STYLE BIBLE below and apply it to EVERY panel I send afterwards. Reply only with "STYLE LOCKED" and wait for the first panel.',
    "",
    "STYLE BIBLE",
    `- Art style: ${styleDescription(bible)}`,
    `- Frame: ${describeAspectRatio(aspectRatio)}`,
    `- Characters (keep identical in every panel): ${bible.characters.trim() || "none specified; keep any recurring subject visually identical"}`,
    `- Color palette: ${bible.palette.trim() || "follow the art style"}`,
    `- Recurring locations: ${bible.locations.trim() || "n/a"}`,
    `- Extra rules: ${bible.extraRules.trim() || "n/a"}`,
    "- Global rules: exactly one single frame per image (no collage, no grid, no panels side by side), no speech bubbles, no captions, no watermark, no text inside the image.",
  ];
  if (topic.trim()) lines.push("", `Video topic (context only): ${topic.trim()}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

/** Prompt per panel (scene). Dalam bahasa Inggris karena AI gambar paling stabil dengan itu. */
export function buildPanelPrompt(
  scene: StoryboardScene,
  total: number,
  opts: { aspectRatio: string; cameraMovementEnabled: boolean }
): string {
  const cam = parseCameraSetting(scene.settingKamera);
  const visual = cleanVisualForStill(scene.visual);
  const lines: string[] = [
    `PANEL ${scene.index}/${total}. Apply the locked STYLE BIBLE and keep the same characters. Generate ONE image, aspect ratio ${describeAspectRatio(opts.aspectRatio)}.`,
  ];
  if (scene.context?.trim()) lines.push(`Scene: ${scene.context.trim()}`);
  lines.push(`Draw the single most representative keyframe of this action (a still frame, not a sequence): ${visual || "(no visual description provided)"}`);

  if (cam) {
    const bits = [
      cam.shotSize && `shot size ${cam.shotSize}`,
      cam.angle && `angle ${cam.angle}`,
      cam.lens && `lens ${cam.lens}`,
      cam.depthOfField && `depth of field ${cam.depthOfField}`,
      cam.composition && `composition ${cam.composition}`,
    ].filter((x): x is string => Boolean(x));
    if (bits.length) lines.push(`Camera: ${bits.join("; ")}.`);
  } else {
    lines.push("Camera: choose the framing that best fits the action.");
  }

  if (!opts.cameraMovementEnabled) {
    lines.push("Camera movement: static (do not draw motion arrows).");
  } else if (cam?.movement && cam.movement.toLowerCase() !== "static") {
    lines.push(`Camera movement: ${cam.movement}. Show it only as a subtle arrow overlay if the style allows.`);
  } else {
    lines.push("Camera movement: static (do not draw motion arrows).");
  }

  lines.push("Do not add any text, caption, or watermark inside the image.");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function naturalCompare(a: string, b: string): number {
  return a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
}

/** Urutkan nama file secara natural (panel2 < panel10) lalu pasangkan ke Scene 1..N. */
export function assignFilesToScenes(
  names: string[],
  totalScenes: number
): { name: string; sceneNumber: number | null }[] {
  const sorted = [...names].sort(naturalCompare);
  return sorted.map((name, i) => ({ name, sceneNumber: i + 1 <= totalScenes ? i + 1 : null }));
}

import { prisma } from "./db";
import { enforceChannelLimits } from "./channelLockLogic";
import { notifyUser } from "./notifications";

export class SubscriptionInactiveError extends Error {
  constructor(message = "Subscription inactive or expired.") {
    super(message);
    this.name = "SubscriptionInactiveError";
  }
}

export async function getSubscriptionState(userId: string) {
  let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    include: { currentPlan: true }
  });
  if (!user) throw new Error("User not found");

  const now = new Date();

  // P1-11: Terapkan downgrade jika tanggal efektif pending plan sudah tiba
  if (user.pendingPlanId && user.pendingPlanEffectiveAt && user.pendingPlanEffectiveAt <= now) {
    user = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: {
        currentPlanId: user.pendingPlanId,
        pendingPlanId: null,
        pendingPlanEffectiveAt: null
      },
      include: { currentPlan: true }
    });
    await enforceChannelLimits(userId);
  }

  let isActive = user.subscriptionStatus === "ACTIVE" && 
                   user.subscriptionExpiresAt !== null && 
                   user.subscriptionExpiresAt > now;

  // Enforce side effects (Spec 3.4)
  if (!isActive && user.subscriptionStatus === "ACTIVE") {
    user = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { subscriptionStatus: "EXPIRED" },
      include: { currentPlan: true }
    });
    isActive = false;
    await enforceChannelLimits(userId);
    await notifyUser(
      userId,
      "SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED",
      "subscriptionExpiredTitle",
      "subscriptionExpiredMsg",
      "/dashboard/billing"
    );
  } else if (isActive && user.subscriptionExpiresAt) {
    const threeDaysMs = 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const timeLeft = user.subscriptionExpiresAt.getTime() - now.getTime();
    if (timeLeft > 0 && timeLeft <= threeDaysMs) {
      // Avoid duplicate notification if issued within the last 24h
      const oneDayAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const recentNotif = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
        where: {
          userId,
          type: "SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRING_SOON",
          createdAt: { gte: oneDayAgo }
        }
      });

      if (!recentNotif) {
        const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(timeLeft / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)));
        await notifyUser(
          userId,
          "SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRING_SOON",
          "subscriptionExpiringTitle",
          "subscriptionExpiringMsg",
          "/dashboard/billing",
          { daysLeft }
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    isActive,
    user,
    plan: user.currentPlan
  };
}

export async function requireActiveSubscription(userId: string) {
  const { isActive, user, plan } = await getSubscriptionState(userId);
  if (user.role === "SUPERADMIN") return { user, plan };

  if (!isActive) {
    throw new Error("Subscription inactive or expired.");
  }
  return { user, plan };
}

/**
 * Visual Style Map — 15 preset gaya estetika untuk visual prompt generation.
 * Ported from Push App's generate route and adapted for Prompt Gen SaaS.
 *
 * Used by:
 *  - src/app/api/generate/route.ts (server-side prompt injection)
 *  - src/components/generator/GeneratorForm.tsx (UI dropdown)
 */

export interface VisualStyleEntry {
  label: string;
  prompt: string;
}

export const VISUAL_STYLE_MAP: Record<string, VisualStyleEntry> = {
  "photorealistic": {
    label: "Fotografi Realistis (Photorealistic)",
    prompt: "8k photography, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, shot on 35mm lens --style raw"
  },

  },

    prompt: "hand-drawn anime style, Studio Ghibli aesthetic, watercolor backgrounds, soft whimsical lighting"
  },
  "cyberpunk": {
    label: "Cyberpunk & Neon Glow",
    prompt: "cyberpunk theme, futuristic city, glowing neon lights, rain-slicked streets, purple and teal palette"
  },
  "flat-vector": {
    label: "Vektor Ilustrasi Flat Art",
    prompt: "clean vector illustration style, modern flat design, minimalist lines, solid colors"
  },
  "watercolor": {
    label: "Sketsa Cat Air & Ink Wash",
    prompt: "watercolor and ink wash paint style, organic textures, soft color washes, paper texture"
  },
  "synthwave": {
    label: "Retro 80s Synthwave",
    prompt: "80s retro synthwave style, dark neon colors, laser grids, sunset glow"
  },
  "vintage-kodak": {
    label: "Sinematik Film Grain (Kodak Portra)",
    prompt: "analog film photography, Kodak Portra look, warm tones, subtle film grain, natural shadows"
  },

    prompt: "minimalist black and white line art, cute simple doodle style"

    prompt: "classic oil painting style, visible brush strokes, rich texture, canvas detail"
  }
};

/**
 * Resolve a visual style key (or free-text label) to its Midjourney-ready prompt string.
 * Falls back to fuzzy matching for common terms, then returns the raw string if no match.
 */
export function resolveVisualStyle(style: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!style) return null;

  // Exact key match
  if (VISUAL_STYLE_MAP[style]) {
    return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP[style].prompt;
  }

  const lowerStyle = style.toLowerCase();

  // Fuzzy fallbacks
  if (lowerStyle.includes('pixar')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['pixar'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('ghibli') || lowerStyle.includes('anime')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['ghibli'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('cyberpunk') || lowerStyle.includes('neon')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['cyberpunk'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('kodak') || lowerStyle.includes('film grain')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['vintage-kodak'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('realistis') || lowerStyle.includes('photorealistic') || lowerStyle.includes('photography')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['photorealistic'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('watercolor') || lowerStyle.includes('cat air') || lowerStyle.includes('moody wash')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['watercolor'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('synthwave') || lowerStyle.includes('retro 80')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['synthwave'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('fantasi') || lowerStyle.includes('gotik') || lowerStyle.includes('gothic')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['dark-fantasy'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('claymation') || lowerStyle.includes('tanah liat')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['claymation'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('isometric')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['isometric'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('comic') || lowerStyle.includes('pop art')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['pop-art'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('line art') || lowerStyle.includes('doodle')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['line-art'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('oil paint') || lowerStyle.includes('lukisan')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['oil-painting'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('sinematik') || lowerStyle.includes('cinematic')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['photorealistic'].prompt;
  if (lowerStyle.includes('flat') || lowerStyle.includes('vector') || lowerStyle.includes('vektor')) return VISUAL_STYLE_MAP['flat-vector'].prompt;

  // Return raw string if no match (allows custom style input)
  return style;
}

/**
 * Map a free-text `channel.visualAesthetic` string (stored in ProfileChannel)
 * to the nearest VISUAL_STYLE_MAP slug key for use in dropdowns and imageConfig.
 *
 * Returns null if no reasonable match — caller should leave the field at its
 * current value (e.g. keep user's manual selection intact).
 *
 * Fix #58: Previously, GeneratorForm set imageConfig.visualStyle to the raw
 * `channel.visualAesthetic` text (e.g. "Cinematic Dark Mode (Sleek & Professional)"),
 * which then fuzzy-matched to "photorealistic" — an incorrect mapping.
 */
export function mapVisualAestheticToKey(aesthetic: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!aesthetic) return null;
  const lower = aesthetic.toLowerCase();

  // Exact slug match first
  if (VISUAL_STYLE_MAP[aesthetic]) return aesthetic;

  // Ordered priority: most specific terms first
  if (lower.includes('ghibli')) return 'ghibli';
  if (lower.includes('anime') || lower.includes('manga')) return 'ghibli';
  if (lower.includes('pixar')) return 'pixar';
  if (lower.includes('cyberpunk') || lower.includes('neon glow')) return 'cyberpunk';
  if (lower.includes('kodak') || lower.includes('film grain') || lower.includes('analog')) return 'vintage-kodak';
  if (lower.includes('synthwave') || lower.includes('retro 80') || lower.includes('80s')) return 'synthwave';
  if (lower.includes('dark fantasy') || lower.includes('gotik') || lower.includes('gothic') || lower.includes('dark mode')) return 'dark-fantasy';
  if (lower.includes('claymation') || lower.includes('tanah liat')) return 'claymation';
  if (lower.includes('isometric')) return 'isometric';
  if (lower.includes('pop art') || lower.includes('comic book')) return 'pop-art';
  if (lower.includes('line art') || lower.includes('doodle') || lower.includes('minimalist line')) return 'line-art';
  if (lower.includes('oil paint') || lower.includes('lukisan klasik')) return 'oil-painting';
  if (lower.includes('fairy') || lower.includes('dongeng')) return 'fairytale';
  if (lower.includes('watercolor') || lower.includes('cat air') || lower.includes('ink wash')) return 'watercolor';
  if (lower.includes('flat') || lower.includes('vector') || lower.includes('vektor')) return 'flat-vector';
  if (lower.includes('sinematik') || lower.includes('cinematic') || lower.includes('photorealistic') || lower.includes('photography') || lower.includes('realistis')) return 'photorealistic';

  return null; // no mapping — keep existing value
}

/** Get all visual style entries as an array for UI dropdowns. */
export function getVisualStyleOptions(): Array<{ value: string; label: string }> {
  return Object.entries(VISUAL_STYLE_MAP).map(([key, entry]) => ({
    value: key,
    label: entry.label,
  }));
}

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { isCronAuthorized } from "@/lib/cronAuth";

const SECRET = "test-secret-1234567890-abcdef";

function makeReq(url: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Request {
  return new Request(url, { headers });
}

describe("isCronAuthorized", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  });

  it("menolak semua request jika CRON_SECRET tidak diatur", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", "");
    const req = makeReq("http://localhost/api/cron/x", {
      authorization: "Bearer promptgen_cron_internal_secret",
    });
    expect(isCronAuthorized(req)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("menolak jika CRON_SECRET terlalu pendek", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", "pendek");
    const req = makeReq("http://localhost/api/cron/x", { authorization: "Bearer pendek" });
    expect(isCronAuthorized(req)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("menerima Bearer token yang benar", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", SECRET);
    const req = makeReq("http://localhost/api/cron/x", { authorization: `Bearer ${SECRET}` });
    expect(isCronAuthorized(req)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("menolak Bearer token yang salah", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", SECRET);
    const req = makeReq("http://localhost/api/cron/x", { authorization: "Bearer salah-salah-salah-salah" });
    expect(isCronAuthorized(req)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("menerima secret lewat query string (kompatibilitas)", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", SECRET);
    const req = makeReq(`http://localhost/api/cron/x?secret=${SECRET}`);
    expect(isCronAuthorized(req)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("menolak request tanpa kredensial", () => {
    vi.stubEnv("CRON_SECRET", SECRET);
    expect(isCronAuthorized(makeReq("http://localhost/api/cron/x"))).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { buildGenerationConfigSnapshot } from "@/lib/generationConfig";

describe("buildGenerationConfigSnapshot", () => {
  const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z");

  it("null jika prefs bukan objek", () => {
    expect(buildGenerationConfigSnapshot(null, "ch1", NOW)).toBeNull();
    expect(buildGenerationConfigSnapshot("x", "ch1", NOW)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("memakai channelFormStates[channelId] dan hanya field whitelist", () => {
    const prefs = {
      channelFormStates: {
        ch1: {
          outputLanguage: "English",
          cameraMovementEnabled: false,
          secretField: "JANGAN DISALIN",
          videoConfig: { aspectRatio: "9:16", targetSceneCount: 7, apiKey: "rahasia" },
        },
      },
    };
    const snap = buildGenerationConfigSnapshot(prefs, "ch1", NOW);
    expect(snap).not.toBeNull();
    expect(snap?.source).toBe("channelFormStates");
    expect(snap?.capturedAt).toBe("2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(snap?.cameraMovementEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(JSON.stringify(snap)).not.toContain("JANGAN DISALIN");
    expect(JSON.stringify(snap)).not.toContain("rahasia");
    expect(JSON.stringify(snap)).toContain("9:16");
  });

  it("fallback ke generatorFormState jika channelId cocok", () => {
    const prefs = { generatorFormState: { channelId: "ch2", outputLanguage: "Indonesia" } };
    expect(buildGenerationConfigSnapshot(prefs, "ch2", NOW)?.source).toBe("generatorFormState");
    expect(buildGenerationConfigSnapshot(prefs, "lain", NOW)).toBeNull();
  });
});

FILE: src/lib/__tests__/imageKind.test.ts

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { detectImageKind } from "@/lib/imageKind";

function pad(bytes: number[], total = 16): Buffer {
  const b = Buffer.alloc(total);
  bytes.forEach((v, i) => { b[i] = v; });
  return b;
}

describe("detectImageKind", () => {
  it("mengenali JPEG", () => expect(detectImageKind(pad([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0]))).toBe("jpeg"));
  it("mengenali PNG", () =>
    expect(detectImageKind(pad([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]))).toBe("png"));
  it("mengenali WebP", () => {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(16);
    b.write("RIFF", 0, "ascii");
    b.write("WEBP", 8, "ascii");
    expect(detectImageKind(b)).toBe("webp");
  });
  it("menolak SVG, GIF, dan teks", () => {
    expect(detectImageKind(Buffer.from("<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'></svg>"))).toBeNull();
    expect(detectImageKind(Buffer.from("GIF89a000000000000"))).toBeNull();
    expect(detectImageKind(Buffer.from("halo dunia"))).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import sharp from "sharp";
import { processPanelImage } from "@/lib/imageProcessing";
import { detectImageKind } from "@/lib/imageKind";

describe("processPanelImage", () => {
  it("mengonversi PNG besar ke WebP + thumbnail", async () => {
    const png = await sharp({
      create: { width: 2400, height: 4200, channels: 3, background: { r: 200, g: 50, b: 50 } },
    })
      .png()
      .toBuffer();
    expect(detectImageKind(png)).toBe("png");
    const out = await processPanelImage(png);
    expect(detectImageKind(out.main)).toBe("webp");
    expect(Math.max(out.width, out.height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1280);
    const t = await sharp(out.thumb).metadata();
    expect(Math.max(t.width ?? 0, t.height ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
  });

  it("menolak data yang bukan gambar", async () => {
    await expect(processPanelImage(Buffer.from("bukan gambar sama sekali"))).rejects.toThrow();
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { parseScenes } from "@/lib/parsers";

const SAMPLE = `JUDUL TERPILIH: This Pig's Tusks Grow Straight Through Its Own Face - Babirusa

CAPTION: Tusks that grow straight through its face, and yes, it's a pig!
HASHTAGS: #babirusa #wildlifefacts

## SCENE 1
SCENE CONTEXT: Close-up of a male babirusa with tusks piercing its snout.
NARASI: [fast, intense] This babirusa's tusks grow straight through its own face. [SFX: Impact Hit] [beat] Yes, that's a pig.
TARGET EMOSI (VET): Shock
TEKNIK EDITING & PACING: Jump Cut (0s dead-air)
TEKS OVERLAY: [KEY POINT] Tusks through the face?!
PANDUAN SUARA: Sample Context: Hushed jungle; Director's Note: urgent whisper
VISUAL PROMPT: Extreme close-up of a male babirusa, slow push-in, cinematic lighting, accompanied by [SFX: Impact Hit] --ar 9:16
DURASI: 5 detik

## SCENE 2
SCENE CONTEXT: Wide shot of the babirusa wading through a Sulawesi swamp.
NARASI: Found only in Indonesia, this forest oddity looks like a prehistoric creature.
TARGET EMOSI (VET): Curiosity
TEKNIK EDITING & PACING: B-Roll Cutaway Overlay
TEKS OVERLAY: —
PANDUAN SUARA: —
VISUAL PROMPT: Wide establishing shot of a babirusa in a misty swamp, slow pan left, no sound effects --ar 9:16
DURASI: 7 detik
`;

describe("parseScenes (baseline perilaku saat ini)", () => {
  it("menemukan 2 scene", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(SAMPLE);
    expect(scenes).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("mengisi field utama scene 1", () => {
    const [s1] = parseScenes(SAMPLE);
    expect(s1.sceneContext).toContain("Close-up of a male babirusa");
    expect(s1.narasi).toContain("tusks grow straight through its own face");
    expect(s1.targetEmosi).toBe("Shock");
    expect(s1.teknikPacing).toContain("Jump Cut");
    expect(s1.visual).toContain("slow push-in");
    expect(s1.durasi).toBe("5s");
  });

  it("mengisi scene 2 dan durasi 7s", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(SAMPLE);
    expect(scenes[1].visual).toContain("slow pan left");
    expect(scenes[1].durasi).toBe("7s");
  });

  it("scene tanpa baris SETTING KAMERA tidak punya settingKamera (kompatibel dengan data lama)", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(SAMPLE);
    expect(scenes[0].settingKamera).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("parseScenes — SETTING KAMERA", () => {
  const WITH_CAM = SAMPLE.replace(
    "VISUAL PROMPT:",
    "SETTING KAMERA: ECU | low angle | 50mm | shallow DOF | slow push-in | rule of thirds\nVISUAL PROMPT:"
  );

  it("membaca SETTING KAMERA pada scene yang memilikinya", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(WITH_CAM);
    expect(scenes).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(scenes[0].settingKamera).toBe("ECU | low angle | 50mm | shallow DOF | slow push-in | rule of thirds");
  });

  it("SETTING KAMERA tidak bocor ke field visual", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(WITH_CAM);
    expect(scenes[0].visual).not.toContain("SETTING KAMERA");
    expect(scenes[0].visual).toContain("slow push-in");
  });

  it("scene lain tanpa baris kamera tetap undefined", () => {
    const scenes = parseScenes(WITH_CAM);
    expect(scenes[1].settingKamera).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { generateMasterPrompt } from "@/lib/promptGenerator";

type ChannelArg = Parameters<typeof generateMasterPrompt>[0];
type VideoArg = Parameters<typeof generateMasterPrompt>[3];

const channel = {
  channelName: "Zoonation",
  niche: "Reptil dan hewan unik",
  targetAudience: "umum",
  language: "id",
  contentType: "VIDEO",
  tone: "Formal Documentary",
} as ChannelArg;

function build(cameraMovementEnabled: boolean, outputLanguage: string): string {
  const videoConfig = {
    targetPlatform: "YouTube Shorts",
    targetDurationSec: 50,
    targetSceneCount: 7,
    aspectRatio: "9:16",
    speechRate: 0.4,
    cameraMovementEnabled,
  } as VideoArg;
  const result = generateMasterPrompt(channel, "Hewan hutan", "", videoConfig, null, [], outputLanguage, null);
  return typeof result === "string" ? result : JSON.stringify(result);
}

describe("generateMasterPrompt — baris SETTING KAMERA", () => {
  for (const lang of ["English", "Indonesia"]) {
    it(`kamera aktif (${lang}): label ada di daftar label, SCENE 1, dan SCENE 2`, () => {
      const out = build(true, lang);
      expect((out.match(/SETTING KAMERA:/g) ?? []).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
      expect(out).toContain("slow push-in");
    });

    it(`kamera dimatikan (${lang}): bagian gerakan wajib static`, () => {
      const out = build(false, lang);
      expect(out).toContain("SETTING KAMERA:");
      expect(out).toContain("WAJIB diisi static");
    });
  }
});

let dir = "";

beforeAll(async () => {
  dir = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "pg-storage-"));
  vi.stubEnv("STORAGE_DIR", dir);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  await fs.rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

describe("storage", () => {
  it("menulis, membaca, dan menghapus file", async () => {
    await storagePut("storyboard/u1/d1/a.webp", Buffer.from("halo"));
    const got = await storageGet("storyboard/u1/d1/a.webp");
    expect(got?.toString()).toBe("halo");
    await storageDelete("storyboard/u1/d1/a.webp");
    expect(await storageGet("storyboard/u1/d1/a.webp")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("menolak key berbahaya", async () => {
    await expect(storagePut("../evil.txt", Buffer.from("x"))).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(storagePut("/etc/passwd", Buffer.from("x"))).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(storagePut("a/../../b.txt", Buffer.from("x"))).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(storagePut("UPPER/case.txt", Buffer.from("x"))).rejects.toThrow();
  });

  it("menghapus file yang tidak ada tidak error", async () => {
    await expect(storageDelete("storyboard/none/none/x.webp")).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("storageList mengembalikan key relatif", async () => {
    await storagePut("storyboard/u2/d2/b.webp", Buffer.from("1"));
    const list = await storageList("storyboard");
    expect(list.map((f) => f.key)).toContain("storyboard/u2/d2/b.webp");
  });
});

describe("extractStoryboardScenes", () => {

    const out = extractStoryboardScenes({
      scenes: [
        { sceneContext: "A", visual: "v1", settingKamera: "MS | eye-level" },
        "bukan objek",
        { visual: "—" },
      ],
    });
    expect(out).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(out[0]).toMatchObject({ index: 1, context: "A", visual: "v1", settingKamera: "MS | eye-level" });
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ index: 2, visual: "" });
  });
  it("kosong untuk data lama / tidak valid", () => {
    expect(extractStoryboardScenes(null)).toEqual([]);
    expect(extractStoryboardScenes({ segments: [] })).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("readStyleBible", () => {
  it("default jika kosong atau artStyle tidak valid", () => {
    expect(readStyleBible(null).artStyle).toBe("bw_sketch");
    expect(readStyleBible({ styleBible: { artStyle: "ngawur", characters: "X" } }).artStyle).toBe("bw_sketch");
    expect(readStyleBible({ styleBible: { artStyle: "watercolor", characters: "X" } }).characters).toBe("X");
  });
});

describe("config readers", () => {
  it("aspect ratio default 9:16", () => {
    expect(readAspectRatio(null)).toBe("9:16");
    expect(readAspectRatio({ videoConfig: { aspectRatio: "16:9" } })).toBe("16:9");
  });
  it("camera movement hanya false jika eksplisit false", () => {
    expect(readCameraMovementEnabled(null)).toBe(true);
    expect(readCameraMovementEnabled({ cameraMovementEnabled: false })).toBe(false);
  });
});

    settingKamera: "ECU | low angle | 50mm | shallow DOF | slow push-in | rule of thirds",

  });
  it("static jika camera movement dimatikan", () => {
    const p = buildPanelPrompt(scene, 7, { aspectRatio: "9:16", cameraMovementEnabled: false });
    expect(p).toContain("Camera movement: static");
    expect(p).not.toContain("slow push-in.");
  });
  it("tetap valid untuk scene lama tanpa setting kamera", () => {
    const p = buildPanelPrompt({ index: 2, visual: "A swamp" }, 7, { aspectRatio: "16:9", cameraMovementEnabled: true });
    expect(p).toContain("choose the framing");
    expect(p).toContain("horizontal 16:9");
  });

    expect(r.map((x) => x.sceneNumber)).toEqual([1, 2, null]);
  });

import { prisma } from "../db";
import { enforceChannelLimits } from "../channelLockLogic";
import { CreateInvoiceInput, PaymentProvider } from "./types";
import { notifyUser } from "../notifications";

export class ManualTransferProvider implements PaymentProvider {
  name = "Manual Transfer";
  method = "MANUAL_TRANSFER" as const;

  async createInvoice(input: CreateInvoiceInput): Promise<{ invoiceId: string; paymentUrl?: string }> {
    const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: input.planId } });
    if (!plan) throw new Error("Plan not found");

    const invoice = await prisma.invoice.create({
      data: {
        userId: input.userId,
        planId: input.planId,
        amount: input.amount,
        method: "MANUAL_TRANSFER",
        status: "PENDING",
        periodDays: plan.periodDays || 30 // P0-3: Baca dari plan.periodDays
      }
    });
    
    return { invoiceId: invoice.id };
  }

  async verifyPayment(invoiceId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // Manual transfer relies on admin approval, so verifyPayment just checks if proof exists
    const invoice = await prisma.invoice.findUnique({ where: { id: invoiceId } });
    return !!(invoice && invoice.proofUrl);
  }

  getPaymentInstructions(): string {
    return "Silakan transfer ke rekening bank kami dan unggah bukti transfer pembayaran Anda.";
  }
}

export async function activateSubscription(invoiceId: string, reviewedById: string) {
  const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // We use findFirst to get the invoice, but the actual status check 
    // happens inside an updateMany to prevent TOCTOU race conditions.
    const invoice = await tx.invoice.findUnique({
      where: { id: invoiceId },
      include: { plan: true }
    });

    if (!invoice) throw new Error("Invoice not found");

    const updateResult = await tx.invoice.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: invoiceId,
        status: "PENDING"
      },
      data: {
        status: "APPROVED",
        reviewedById,
        reviewedAt: new Date()
      }
    });

    if (updateResult.count === 0) {
      throw new Error("Invoice is no longer PENDING or already processed.");
    }

    const user = await tx.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: invoice.userId },
      include: { currentPlan: true }
    });
    if (!user) throw new Error("User not found");

    const now = new Date();
    let newExpiresAt = new Date();
    const isCurrentlyActive = user.subscriptionStatus === "ACTIVE" && user.subscriptionExpiresAt && user.subscriptionExpiresAt > now;

    if (isCurrentlyActive && user.subscriptionExpiresAt) {
      newExpiresAt = new Date(user.subscriptionExpiresAt);
    }
    newExpiresAt.setDate(newExpiresAt.getDate() + invoice.periodDays);

    // P1-11: Kebijakan Upgrade / Downgrade Eksplisit
    const isDowngrade = isCurrentlyActive && user.currentPlan && (invoice.plan.priceMonthly < user.currentPlan.priceMonthly);

    if (isDowngrade) {
      // Downgrade: jadwalkan setelah masa paket aktif yang lebih tinggi habis
      await tx.user.update({
        where: { id: invoice.userId },
        data: {
          subscriptionStatus: "ACTIVE",
          subscriptionExpiresAt: newExpiresAt,
          pendingPlanId: invoice.planId,
          pendingPlanEffectiveAt: new Date(user.subscriptionExpiresAt!)
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Upgrade atau perpanjangan setara: langsung naik tier dan kumulatif
      await tx.user.update({
        where: { id: invoice.userId },
        data: {
          subscriptionStatus: "ACTIVE",
          currentPlanId: invoice.planId,
          subscriptionExpiresAt: newExpiresAt,
          pendingPlanId: null,
          pendingPlanEffectiveAt: null
        }
      });
    }

    await enforceChannelLimits(invoice.userId, tx);

    return invoice;
  });

  // Send in-app notification to user
  await notifyUser(
    result.userId,
    "PAYMENT_APPROVED",
    "paymentApprovedTitle",
    "paymentApprovedMsg",
    "/dashboard/billing",
    { planName: result.plan?.name || "Premium" }
  );

  return result;
}

export interface CreateInvoiceInput {
  userId: string;
  planId: string;
  amount: number;
}

export interface PaymentProvider {
  name: string;
  method: "MANUAL_TRANSFER" | "AUTOMATIC_GATEWAY";
  createInvoice(input: CreateInvoiceInput): Promise<{ invoiceId: string; paymentUrl?: string }>;
  verifyPayment(invoiceId: string, proofData?: string): Promise<boolean>;
  getPaymentInstructions(): string;
}

import { DefaultSession, DefaultUser } from "next-auth";
import { DefaultJWT } from "next-auth/jwt";

declare module "next-auth" {
  interface Session {
    user: {
      id: string;
      role: string;
      registrationStatus?: string;
      mustChangePassword?: boolean;
    } & DefaultSession["user"];
  }

  interface User extends DefaultUser {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    registrationStatus?: string;
    rememberMe?: boolean;
    mustChangePassword?: boolean;
  }
}

declare module "next-auth/jwt" {
  interface JWT extends DefaultJWT {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    registrationStatus?: string;
    rememberMe?: boolean;
    mustChangePassword?: boolean;
    checkedAt?: number;
    passwordChangedAt?: string | null;
  }
}
